transport.port_of_loading: Ho Chi Minh City (Cat Lai), Vietnam

items.description: Long grain white rice, 5% broken, in 50 kg PP bags

expected_discrepancies.detail: Invoice states country of origin Thailand (TH); certificate of origin certifies Viet Nam and the B/L shows the shipper in Vietnam

checklist.question: Who is the importer and what is their TIN?
checklist.settled_by: Invoice sold-to and B/L consignee agree

checklist.question: Who is the exporter and what is the country of origin?
checklist.settled_by: Certificate of origin governs origin (Viet Nam); invoice origin line contradicts it and must be flagged

checklist.question: What are the goods and what HS code applies?
checklist.settled_by: Invoice description; HS 1006.30 for semi-milled or wholly milled rice

checklist.question: How many packages, boards, and what gross and net weight?
checklist.settled_by: Packing list; B/L gross weight must agree

checklist.question: What is the invoice total, currency and incoterm, and the customs value in GMD?
checklist.settled_by: Invoice total CIF Banjul x exchange rate

checklist.question: Do weights, package counts, references and parties agree across all documents?
checklist.settled_by: Comparison of invoice, packing list, B/L, CoO. Expected discrepancy: the invoice says origin Thailand while the certificate of origin certifies Viet Nam; weights and counts agree
